$comment: Synced from soysebiche/sebiche-brand (design-system/project/tokens.json); do not edit here, change it in the design system and copy it over. Site-only values (product map, symbol geometry, fluid type sizes, weight/leading/tracking scales) live in brand/site.json. Run `npm run brand` after syncing: scripts/brand-tokens.mjs resolves {alias} refs and flattens both files into brand/tokens.flat.json, which Tailwind, lib/og.tsx, the manifest and the symbol component read. See BRAND.md.
name: Sebiche

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background for every section (body, hero, products, approach).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Product card fill on ground. Also available as the alias surface-card.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Alias of surface kept for older code (app/tokens.css declares --surface-card: var(--surface)). Use surface in new work.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Product card fill on hover.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Contact form panel and product screen section.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: The 86 block and product scenes section.

tokens.name: surface-frame
tokens.usage: Behind product screenshots inside a hairline frame.

tokens.name: surface-nav
tokens.usage: Header and mobile menu fill under 980px.

tokens.name: surface-closing
tokens.usage: Closing section base under its photo overlay.

tokens.name: surface-photo
tokens.usage: Fallback fill behind the hero and closing photos while they load.

tokens.name: surface-photo-mono
tokens.usage: Fallback fill behind the monochrome operations photo.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary text and wordmark on every dark surface (17:1 on ground).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on every page: intros, pillar body, form labels, proof notes (7.2:1 on ground).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Product card description text on surface-card.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, grid cells and image frames on every page.

tokens.name: rule-input
tokens.usage: Bottom border of form inputs at rest.

tokens.name: rule-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu button border and menu bottom edge.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Header bottom border over the hero photo.

tokens.name: rule-footer
tokens.usage: Footer top border over the closing photo.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Brand accent and RestOS identity: eyebrows, marks, card outline, input focus (5.2:1 on ground).

tokens.name: copper-action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; white text on it reads 5.8:1.

tokens.name: copper-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: copper-light
tokens.usage: Inline action link inside the contact error box.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline, offset 3px (4.3:1 on ground).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: TipTrack identity and the second pillar mark (5.4:1 on ground).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: 86MISE identity (5.6:1 on ground).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Third pillar mark only (7.4:1 on ground).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on copper, violet or orange fills (product identity panel, status block).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Button label on copper-action.

tokens.name: ticket-paper
tokens.usage: Order ticket card fill over the hero photo.

tokens.name: ticket-ink
tokens.usage: Monospace text on ticket-paper.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight; text stays paper.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Faint copper radial glow in the page background (one per hero and closing section).

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: --text-display-2xl: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 8rem). Closing call to action.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: --text-display-xl: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 7rem). The h1 of every page (home, product, contact).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: --text-display-l: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 6rem). Section headlines.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: --text-display-m: clamp(2.5rem, 4.5vw, 5rem). Block headlines inside a section.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: --text-display-sm: 3.4rem. Section headlines on mobile.

styles.name: display-sm-hero
styles.usage: --text-display-sm-hero: clamp(3.4rem, 16vw, 5rem). The h1 on mobile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: --text-title: clamp(1.8rem, 2.75vw, 3rem). Product name on its card; secondary section headings.

styles.name: step
styles.usage: --text-step: clamp(1.2rem, 1.7vw, 1.75rem). Workflow steps, capabilities and pillar titles.

styles.name: numeral-86
styles.usage: --text-numeral-86: clamp(8rem, 15vw, 15rem). The 86 block. One editorial numeral per page.

styles.name: numeral-proof
styles.usage: --text-numeral-proof: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 10rem). Proof figure on product pages, in the product accent.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: --text-caption: 1.2rem. Editorial caption under the 86 numeral.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: The <em> inside a display headline: inherits the headline size, tracking --tracking-accent (-0.035em).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: --text-wordmark: clamp(1rem, 1.45vw, 1.35rem). The live wordmark in the header, always uppercase. Logo files outline it.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: --text-glyph: 1.7rem. Pillar glyphs in copper, violet and olive.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Una familia de productos creada desde la operación real.
styles.usage: --text-lead: clamp(1rem, 1.3vw, 1.25rem). Intro paragraph in muted, max 34rem wide.

styles.name: base
styles.sample: Explora qué resuelve cada producto, cómo funciona y cuál es su estado real.
styles.usage: --text-base: 0.95rem. Running text and section intros in muted.

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: --text-sm: 0.86rem. Buttons (weight button, 650), card descriptions and lists (400).

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: --text-xs: 0.78rem. Navigation, footer, contact details.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: --text-label: 0.72rem. Eyebrows, card links and section labels, always uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: --text-micro: 0.54rem. Lockup descriptor (bold, tracking descriptor 0.14em, uppercase) and the order ticket (mono).

tokens.name: space-3xs
tokens.usage: Smallest gap: language switch, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Tight gap inside small groups.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Default gap: product heading to its mark, card link spacing.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card and workflow cell padding at desktop.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Column gap in section leads and footers.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its intro.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Large gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Largest fixed gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page side margin under 680px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every surface, card, button, frame and input. The system has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: Only the order ticket floating over the hero photo. Nothing else casts a shadow.

layout.note: Fluid spaces and fixed component sizes. Fluid values are clamp() or vw, so they live here rather than in Spacing.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side margin at desktop (3.5vw); space-gutter-sm under 680px.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm of a section, 5 to 9rem.

tokens.name: space-section-sm
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm of a compact section, 3 to 6rem.

tokens.name: space-cell
tokens.usage: Padding of grid cells and cards, 1 to 1.5rem.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for language and menu buttons.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary button min-height.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header height and top padding of product and contact pages.

tokens.name: header-height-sm
tokens.usage: Header height under 980px.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Product glyph square on a card, and the header symbol.

tokens.name: mark-lg
tokens.usage: Large product glyph square on a product page.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule, frame, card outline and input underline.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline width, in focus.

tokens.name: border-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

duration.note: Motion, part 1. With prefers-reduced-motion there is no animation and no smooth scroll.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Every hover transition (button, card, nav underline), with ease-standard.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Image zoom inside product cards.

tokens.name: duration-entrance
tokens.usage: Hero photo entrance (scale 1.08 to 1.02), with ease-out.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover transitions.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: the hero photo.

lift.note: Motion, part 3: how far things rise on hover (translateY).

tokens.name: lift-button
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: lift-card
tokens.usage: Product card on hover.

photo.note: CSS filter values for editorial photography. Real kitchens in service only.

tokens.name: photo-hero
tokens.usage: Hero photo and the Open Graph images, under veil-hero.

tokens.name: photo-mono
tokens.usage: Operations photo, under veil-mono.

veil.note: Dark overlays laid over photos so text and logos stay legible. Never put the symbol on a photo without one.

tokens.name: veil-hero
tokens.usage: Over the hero photo.

tokens.name: veil-mono
tokens.usage: Over the monochrome operations photo.

tokens.name: veil-closing
tokens.usage: Over the closing photo, 78% to 42%.

tokens.name: veil-share
tokens.usage: Over the photo in Open Graph share images.
